messages.content: I've been exploring different types of oolong tea. Any recommendations?
For oolong, try Taiwanese Dong Ding or Chinese Da Hong Pao. Both have complex flavor profiles.
I actually got a puer cake from Yunnan last month. The aging process is fascinating.
Puer is a wonderful rabbit hole. Aged puer develops earthy, complex flavors over decades.
I'm mostly in ETH and SOL. Thinking about some AI token exposure too.
AI tokens have been trending. Some projects like Render and Fetch.ai are worth researching.
Yeah, I'm particularly interested in the intersection of AI agents and onchain activity.
That's a growing space. Agent-to-agent transactions and onchain memory are exciting frontiers.
